integrity: The upper bound is an explicit four-parameter factorization of the score. The lower bound is an exact symbolic Jacobian certificate with a strictly positive algebraic determinant, replayed from the embedded verification script.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the scalar QPA score and the gate ordering in Eq. (7) of arXiv:2605.25365v1. It proves a maximum local rank of four, not rank four at every parameter point, and does not address Fisher effective dimension, training performance, or generalization.
title: Exact four-dimensional effective QPA scoring family
